mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL YoY and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE changes and 5-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines for 2 consecutive quarters does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 growth and 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL is above 2% YoY, the real interest rate is negative, signaling accommodative monetary policy and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to positive 5-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE levels and 5-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the correlation between HOUST growth and 20-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is increasing and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is decreasing, it signals a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the combination of INDPRO increasing > 1% and UNRATE decreasing > 0.3% does not lead to positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of instances, or if the joint effect of these conditions on 60-day forward returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
